# src/templates

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `root/map-each-spx-field-element-writes`: Map each SPX field `fN` to ONE element `id="fN"` that `update()` writes into by id. Use no hidden `.spx-data` holders and no `_gfx` display split - that older premium-pack style is documented but is not what this project generates.
- **trap** `behaviours/value-write-rule-paints-field-lands`: A value a write rule paints is NOT a field: it lands in textContent on a stamped artwork layer, while every derivation reads a field through getElementById(fN). A second lookup therefore cannot read what a first one wrote, and a write whose value is empty is skipped, so a Reset cannot clear what it filled. Chain a derivation only through a real field the operator owns.
- **trap** `root/give-input-only-holder-never-inline`: Give an input-only holder `class="noacg-data-source"` and never an inline `style="display:none"`. `DATA_SOURCE_CLASS` and `dataSourceCss` are the one source and `e2e/catalog-baseline.spec.ts` gates it.
- **trap** `templates/add-imports-sanctioned-animation-data-importer`: Do not add imports from `src/blocks/**` to `src/templates/**`; the sanctioned animation-data and importer seam is not permission for more upward dependencies. Copy a small reusable helper locally when necessary, and inspect new imports first when wizard or AI suites time out wholesale without a console error.
- **trap** `templates/adding-designs-add-only-their-new`: When adding designs to `scripts/overflow-baseline.json`, add only their new rows by hand and preserve every existing row. Confirm the result with `node scripts/overflow-sweep.mjs --baseline`, rather than replacing the reference with a full re-record.
- **trap** `templates/arm-machine-timers-through-end-entry`: Arm machine timers through `gsap.delayedCall` from a `tl.call` at the end of the entry timeline, never through `setTimeout`. Keep timer arming subject to GSAP callback suppression.
- **trap** `templates/call-whenever-design-emits-apply-changed`: Call `clockDataUpdated()` from `update()` whenever a design emits `clockRuntimeJs`. Apply changed clock data immediately while running, paused, or idle without changing graphic state, and re-arm only when the clock's own fields changed.
- **trap** `templates/check-before-placing-machine-bearing-data`: Check `hasMachineRuntime(js)` before placing machine-bearing data into a saved template. Re-emit the whole animation region if the frozen interpreter predates the machine engine; do not rely on literal-only `spliceAnimData`, and treat a data/runtime mismatch as export-blocking.
- **trap** `templates/escape-field-text-shared-data-reading`: Escape field text at the shared data-reading boundary before it reaches `innerHTML`, using `escapeHtml()` from `ESCAPE_HTML_JS`, including text interpolated into attributes. Do not delegate escaping to design-owned row builders, and verify every catalog variant with `e2e/template-escaping.spec.ts`.
- **trap** `templates/give-each-measured-explicit-position-phase`: Give each measured `tl.add()` an explicit position when a phase contains multiple segments. Do not use a bare relative position such as `'-=N'` after a measured segment.
- **trap** `templates/give-non-wrapping-reveal-mask-flex`: Give a non-wrapping reveal mask in a flex row `flex: none`. Let the row's wrappable lines absorb the available space instead of squeezing the masked label.
- **trap** `templates/guard-every-load-time-dom-rebuild`: Guard every load-time DOM rebuild or paint with the DOM-ready pattern. Make generated runtime safe to load from `<head>` in an exported package.
- **trap** `templates/hide-input-only-data-holders-through`: Hide input-only data holders through the shared `DATA_SOURCE_CLASS` and `dataSourceCss` stylesheet rule, never inline `display: none`. Preserve the empty-image exception handled by `setFieldValue` and restored by `resetGraphicInline`.
- **trap** `templates/inject-shared-logo-markup-last-child`: Inject shared logo markup as the last child of an unfamiliar design. Cap the mark's height instead of fixing it, and put clear space in the mark's margin rather than the container's `column-gap`.
- **trap** `templates/keep-single-text-fit-system-per`: Keep a single text-fit system per imported graphic. Detect `SVG_TEXT_FIT_MARKER` and leave SVG designs to their fit ladder instead of injecting the raster `ensureTextFitRuntime`.
- **trap** `templates/key-each-kit-choice-graphic-type`: Key each kit choice by its graphic type id or `extra:<designId>`, never by a resolved design id or array index. Present each choice as a card with a settled preview of the actual design.
- **trap** `templates/make-empty-logo-slot-leave-both`: Make an empty logo slot leave both shared arrangements unchanged. Remove the hidden image from grid participation together with its margin, and verify with `e2e/wizard-logo.spec.ts`.
- **trap** `templates/measure-stage-reserves-layout-dimensions-never`: Measure stage reserves from layout dimensions, never visual bounding rects. Keep the shipped inline `height` and `min-height` reserves stable across recalibration and webfont changes, and verify with `e2e/stage-fit-determinism.spec.ts`.
- **trap** `templates/measure-which-families-resolve-whenever-resolving`: Measure which families resolve whenever re-resolving a pack; do not assume that a passing declared-family cell gate covers the other families. Use the standing gaps report in `docs/KIT_MATRIX_GAPS.md` when assessing kit reach.
- **trap** `templates/omit-imported-designs-through-let-each`: Omit `--type-scale` from imported designs through `rootVarsCss` with `typeScale: false`. Let each placed line size itself so the Style panel does not expose a dead text-size control.
- **trap** `templates/pin-reserve-height-multicolumn-text-block`: Do not pin a reserve height on a multicolumn text block. Verify that its content reflows within the panel through `e2e/catalog/multicol-containment.spec.ts`.
- **trap** `templates/read-animation-speed-through-wherever-design`: Read animation speed through `motionSpeed()` wherever design-owned runtime or a wrapper needs it. Resolve data-driven speed first, then legacy speed, then the default; never depend on the bare `animSpeed` global.
- **trap** `templates/set-serif-figure-columns-all-caps`: Set `font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;` on serif figure columns and all-caps labels. Inspect numeral height and baseline visually rather than relying on the width-stability gate.
- **trap** `templates/use-logo-capability-sole-authority-whether`: Use the logo capability as the sole authority for whether a design can offer and draw a logo, following `docs/MARK_CAPABILITY_AUDIT.md`. Gate logo CSS on `logoEnabled` whenever the field is gated, so a disabled slot does not change the default design.
- **rule** `templates/accept-ambient-ranking-input-through-separate`: Accept ambient ranking input through `BrowseContext`, separate from user-selected `BrowseFilters`. Keep its brand-family boost below a genuine programme match, and never expose it as a removable filter chip or clear it through Clear-all.
- **rule** `templates/author-dimensions-resolution-folded-multiply-font`: Author dimensions as `calc(Npx * var(--scale))`, with resolution folded into `--scale` by `computeScale`, and multiply font sizes additionally by `var(--type-scale)`. Let only `font-size` consume `--type-scale`, and use the shared `TYPE_SIZE_STEPS` and graphic-size ladder rather than duplicating size constants.
- **rule** `templates/combine-strict-facets-choices-within-each`: Combine strict facets with AND and choices within each facet with OR; let programme format rank results without hiding them. Expand aliases phrase-first across the supported languages and use a field-weighted token index, with `mostRestrictiveFilter` for zero-result recovery.
- **rule** `templates/compute-countdown-time-deadline-every-tick`: Compute countdown time from a deadline and `Date.now()` on every tick rather than decrementing an interval counter. Keep painting DOM-ready-safe and null-safe, display minutes and seconds with hours when needed, and apply `{prefix}-done` at zero.
- **rule** `templates/create-every-category-data-block-through`: Create every category with a `NOACG_ANIM` data block through `convertToDataRegion`, using `CategorySpec.dataRegion` for standard assembly and a direct call for self-assembled categories. Convert only the marked animation region, preserving design-owned runtime outside it and retaining valid legacy output if conversion fails.
- **rule** `templates/declare-fixed-footprints-through-emit-them`: Declare fixed footprints through `stageWidth` and emit them through `stageBoxCss` and `stageExtraJs`, including the `--stage-width` marker. Measure width and height through `scripts/footprint-stability-sweep.mjs` and its marker-selected gate; do not substitute a `min-width` floor for a stable stage.
- **rule** `templates/declare-graphic-type-structure-fields-state`: Declare a graphic type's structure, fields, state groups, default path, and events independently of its look. Compile it through `variantsFromType` into ordinary variants using category assemblers, and persist a machine only when the derived one is wrong.
- **rule** `templates/declare-logo-support-variant-capability-emit`: Declare logo support as a variant capability and emit an optional logo field only when `ResolvedOptions.logoEnabled` is on. Allocate hand-authored `extraFields` after user fields, or let `applyLogoSlot` inject the standard field, image, and placeholder when `designHasLogoSlot` finds no existing slot.
- **rule** `templates/declare-pipe-splitting-semantics-per-repeating`: Declare pipe-splitting semantics per repeating-data shape. Split schedule rows at the first pipe and stat-list rows at the last pipe so the free-text part may itself contain a pipe.
- **rule** `templates/declare-variant-build-capabilities-through-logo`: Declare a variant's build capabilities through `maxLines`, logo support, `animationPresets`, and `defaultSteps`. Let `defaultSteps` determine untouched `create({})` output for stepped designs, preserving an unset wizard steps choice rather than overriding it with a boolean.
- **rule** `templates/derive-memoize-template-metadata-per-variant`: Derive and memoize template metadata per variant from the compiled schema and shared taxonomy. Exclude `HIDDEN_CONFIG_FIELDS` from visible counts, intersect buckets with reachable field ranges, combine declared and derived capabilities, and derive placement, motion, and complexity rather than duplicating declarations.
- **rule** `templates/derive-programme-relevance-whether-format-pack`: Derive programme relevance from whether a format's pack contains any type matching the design's graphic category. Rank `relevance: 'all'` categories below genuine category matches.
- **rule** `templates/drop-query-tokens-reach-design-result`: Drop query tokens that reach no design from the result AND and return them as `BrowseOutcome.ignored`. Keep `catalogVocabulary()` as the shared matching vocabulary, and index a design id at name weight.
- **rule** `templates/emit-numeric-sibling-bundled-through-only`: Emit a numeric sibling's bundled `@font-face` through `rootVarsCss` only when the numeric token is declared. Give designs without live numbers neither the numeric variable nor the extra font file, and retain CSS font URLs for export discovery.
- **rule** `templates/emit-same-es5-interpreter-every-data`: Emit the same ES5 interpreter in every data-driven template, preserving `buildInTimeline`, `buildOutTimeline`, and `revealNextStep` globals. Emit the complete data header, literal, and interpreter with `emitAnimRegion`, and replace the marked region through `replaceRegionWithAnimData`.
- **rule** `templates/enforce-occasion-admission-through-limit-occasion`: Enforce occasion admission through `validateTaxonomy()`: limit the occasion vocabulary to eight, require at least three designs per occasion, reject nonexistent variant ids, and require every phrase to resolve to its occasion. Run the real-engine search gate over the real catalog.
- **rule** `templates/expose-applicable-plus-every-shape-token`: Expose `--accent`, `--text-color`, `--text-dim`, `--panel-bg`, `--font-heading`, `--scale`, and the applicable `--type-scale`, plus every shape token the stylesheet consumes from `src/model/themeTokens.ts`. Keep style editing on the shared `StyleControls.tsx` contract, marked `@font-face` block, and `zoneDecls` anchoring.
- **rule** `templates/expose-every-meaningful-visible-string-editable`: Expose every meaningful visible string as an editable field, including state words, countdown captions, severity labels, and sponsor headings. Verify editability with `node scripts/field-coverage.mjs`, allowing only the gate's argued versus-mark and empty-image-placeholder exceptions.
- **rule** `templates/express-pixels-reference-1080p-resolution-preserve`: Express `stageWidth` in pixels at the reference 1080p resolution. Preserve the existing emitted output when that option is absent.
- **rule** `templates/fit-placed-shrinkable-raster-text-reducing`: Fit placed shrinkable raster text by reducing font size within its wrapper, never by distorting the typeface, and retain the fifty-five-percent floor. Keep `fitPlacedText()` outside the animation region, inject it idempotently, and refit on updates, DOM readiness, and `document.fonts.ready`.
- **rule** `templates/generate-playout-behaviour-controls-template-machine`: Generate playout behaviour and controls from the template's machine and fields, never from a category or group. Keep taxonomy registries and display labels in `src/model/taxonomy.ts`, and keep display wording out of stored ids.
- **rule** `templates/give-every-design-unique-variant-name`: Give every design a unique variant name and a unique created-template name. If a new design collides with a shipped name, rename the new design.
- **rule** `templates/give-every-new-category-own-thin`: Give every new category its own `AGENTS.md` and thin importing `CLAUDE.md` in its first commit. Keep category lessons at category scope and out of the catalog-wide contract, and use `npm run check:shared-instructions` to check instruction-chain headroom.
- **rule** `templates/implement-data-measured-motion-named-builders`: Implement data-measured motion as named builders outside the marked animation region that measure the DOM and return GSAP objects. Have presets call those builders through `tl.add()` so the importer can represent each segment as `dynamic`; never inline measured math in the region.
- **rule** `templates/keep-discovery-metadata-out-variant-build`: Keep discovery metadata out of the variant's build contract; resolve facets and search through the shared taxonomy, `templateMeta.ts`, and `search.ts`. Define import option shapes in `importedDesign/designTypes.ts` and reference them only as `WizardOptions` members in `contract.ts`.
- **rule** `templates/keep-exact-token-matches-exact-use`: Keep exact token matches exact, and use `wordMatch` only as a fallback for otherwise unreachable tokens, with one-edit or mid-word matches at half weight and one-edit alias misses resolving to that alias. Keep `briefTerm` strictly AND-matched, and omit facet values without catalog matches through the `offered*` helpers.
- **rule** `templates/keep-imported-fonts-template-assets-under`: Keep imported fonts as template assets under `fonts/<file>` with a visible `@font-face`, register them through the FontFace API for builder preview, and ship real font binaries in exports. Accept custom palette values through the wizard's custom palette controls.
- **rule** `templates/keep-internal-assembler-routing-never-label`: Keep `AssemblerId` as an internal assembler and routing id, never a UI label. Add graphic-category presentation metadata above it without renaming stored values or moving design files.
- **rule** `templates/keep-machine-less-interpreter-path-verbatim`: Keep the machine-less interpreter path verbatim when no `machine` key exists. Preserve the SPX lifecycle globals as the public surface, with play resetting and entering, next walking the default path, and stop taking the built-in out from every state.
- **rule** `templates/keep-packs-pure-configuration-over-type`: Keep packs as pure configuration over the type-by-family matrix, with every reference format assigned to exactly one pack. Edit `src/templates/packs.ts` and `docs/PACK_TAXONOMY.md` together, and validate cell resolution, extras, and format coverage through `scripts/factory.mjs`.
- **rule** `templates/keep-rules-describing-only-template-directory`: Keep rules describing only one template directory at that directory's scope rather than in the catalog-wide contract. Read the relevant local contract when editing that directory.
- **rule** `templates/keep-state-wording-editable-data-fields`: Keep state wording in editable data fields or hidden word sources, separate from the machine's state and events. Repaint changed words on `update()` rather than waiting for the state to be entered again.
- **rule** `templates/keep-structural-intent-resolution-shared-routing`: Keep structural intent resolution in `structuralAnchor.ts`, shared by routing and validation, rather than copying it into either consumer. Resolve `resolveAnchor`, `structuralFit`, `anchorsSatisfiedBy`, and `variantSatisfiesAnchor` live against the registry and catalog, and verify routing after catalog changes.
- **rule** `templates/keep-uploaded-asset-references-under-font`: Keep uploaded asset references under `images/<file>` and font references under `fonts/<file>` for the one-folder export layout. Let the preview resolve known relative image paths through its observer shim, and exclude that shim from exported packages.
- **rule** `templates/let-optional-wall-clock-start-time`: Let the optional wall-clock start-time field override duration when filled, and ignore it when empty. Preserve that target across a re-take.
- **rule** `templates/measure-staged-designs-across-full-text`: Measure staged designs across the full text-size ladder with `stage-fit-sweep`, `type-floor`, and `overflow-sweep`, using `--type-scale s|m|l`. Treat text size as an independent verification axis.
- **rule** `templates/offer-generic-broadcast-fields-image-files`: Offer `textfield`, `textarea`, `number`, and `filelist` as generic broadcast fields, with image files under `assetfolder: './images/'`. Reserve `dropdown`, `checkbox`, and `color` for genuinely constrained design choices rather than generic field controls.
- **rule** `templates/pre-hide-press-revealed-layers-using`: Pre-hide press-revealed layers using their first reveal keyframes, falling back to zero opacity, and show or hide the CSS-hidden root through the lifecycle. Fade press-revealed layers outside the root on exit unless the Out step animates them, run `loops` in a separate repeating timeline, and divide durations and keyframe times by `speed`.
- **rule** `templates/preserve-lifecycle-ambient-motion-measured-builders`: Preserve lifecycle `calls`, ambient `loop` motion, and measured `dynamic` builders when converting legacy animation. Use `convertToDataRegion(template, refine?)` to author steps the legacy region cannot represent, and derive lifecycle step counts from the resulting data rather than hard-coding them.
- **rule** `templates/process-events-through-serial-queue-apply`: Process `noacgDispatch` events through one serial queue and apply a flat field payload only after its structural guard accepts. Make `noacgSnap(assignments, opts?)` replay the canonical path instantly with callbacks suppressed, using `null` to restore every group's initial visual state while leaving data reset to `update()`, and expose state through `noacgMachineState()`.
- **rule** `templates/rank-query-named-occasion-above-subtype`: Rank a query's named occasion above subtype, stacking its contribution with category relevance. Make occasion phrases alias keys pointing to facets, never words in the loose text index, and verify them with `npm run test:use-case-search`.
- **rule** `templates/read-before-generating-judging-templates-run`: Read `docs/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md` before generating or judging templates, and run the affected category's catalog sweep after template changes.
- **rule** `templates/record-catalog-baselines-same-change-editing`: Re-record the catalog baselines in the same change when editing `shared/matchClock.ts`; treat the dependent boards' re-serialization as an expected baseline change.
- **rule** `templates/resolve-chosen-heading-typeface-through-using`: Resolve `--font-numeric` from the chosen heading typeface through `numericFontStack`, using even-width heading digits, else its bundled sibling, else a monospaced fallback. Update this token wherever `--font-heading` is written for a numeric design, and verify live-number stability with `scripts/numerals.mjs`.
- **rule** `templates/resolve-declared-metadata-order-then-single`: Resolve declared metadata in the order `VARIANT_META[id]`, `TYPE_META[typeId]`, then the single-valued `CATEGORY_DEFAULT_META[category]`. Keep `TYPE_OCCASIONS` and `VARIANT_OCCASIONS` separate from `DeclaredTemplateMeta`, resolving occasion from variant, else type, else none, with no category fallback or guessed declarations.
- **rule** `templates/resolve-kit-contents-centrally-both-pack`: Resolve kit contents centrally in `kit.ts` from both the pack's type-by-family cells and its `extras`. Have `kitChoices(pack, family)` offer those contents followed by other resolvable graphic types, validate every offered row through `resolvePack`, and resolve selections through `kitSelection`.
- **rule** `templates/resolve-through-first-lower-third-variant`: Resolve `createDefaultTemplate()` through the first lower-third variant, `lt01`, so the unsaved-project fallback has the same source as the catalog design.
- **rule** `templates/return-complete-result-never-add-limit`: Return the complete result from `browseTemplates` and never add a limit argument. Leave pagination to `BrowseStep`, over `best` then `also`, resetting on every filter or sort change and retaining the full total.
- **rule** `templates/ship-every-motion-builder-category-each`: Ship every motion builder for a category in each of its templates so changing a preset only changes the data's `build` name. Accept `(target, opts)` with defaulted `{speed, ease}` options for legacy callers and allow builders to compose other builders.
- **rule** `templates/ship-staged-designs-type-size-their`: Ship staged designs at the type size their CSS declares for their own default words, reserving shrinkage for operator content. Do not impose a stage floor on `line-height`, but keep line masks tall enough for the glyph box and inspect their clipping with the overflow instrument.
- **rule** `templates/start-catalog-verification-run-battery-prints`: Start catalog verification with `npm run catalog:affected` and run the battery it prints, using `--only <ids>` for attributable designs and the whole catalog for shared changes. Use `npm run check:catalog-emit` for the initial emitted-code check.
- **rule** `templates/store-repeating-operator-content-hidden-textarea`: Store repeating operator content in one hidden textarea `lines` field, with one item per line and pipe-separated parts, rather than adding fields per row. Call the type-owned `rebuildInfographic()` after every `update()`, escape text before `innerHTML`, skip malformed lines, and render one direct child per item under `#infographic-rows` for measured row motion.
- **rule** `templates/update-adding-design-keeping-existing-designs`: Update `scripts/overflow-baseline.json`, `e2e/catalog-baseline.json`, and `e2e/catalog-render-baseline.json` when adding a design, keeping existing designs unchanged. Record the latter baselines through `e2e/catalog-baseline.spec.ts` with `UPDATE_CATALOG_BASELINE=1 UPDATE_RENDER_BASELINE=1`; do not treat the catalog-only suite as coverage of that spec.
- **rule** `templates/use-hugging-footprints-default-lower-thirds`: Use hugging footprints by default for lower thirds, corner bugs, end credits, imported designs, tickers, frames, transitions, and versus graphics; declare a fixed stage for other categories. Inside a stage, wrap text and then shrink it to the type floor, never widen the panel.
- **rule** `templates/verify-shared-marks-both-square-portrait`: Verify shared marks with both square and portrait artwork through `e2e/catalog/mark-height.spec.ts`. Check recorded exceptions from both sides so obsolete exceptions fail rather than silently excusing a design.
- **rule** `templates/write-runtime-field-values-through-shared`: Write runtime field values through shared `setFieldValue` from `setFieldValueJs`, using text content for text and `src` for images. Hide empty images and update the parent's `.has-image` state for placeholders; allow data-driven renderers to keep image paths in hidden source fields.
- **taste** `templates/choose-shared-logo-arrangement-category-place`: Choose the shared logo arrangement by category: place a lower-third mark beside the text in a single-row grid with the design's children in `.{prefix}-lockup`, and keep the stacked header band for other categories. Let a strap spend width rather than height.
- **taste** `templates/keep-name-cut-straps-hugging-but`: Keep name-cut straps hugging, but allow `stageWidth` when the design's silhouette requires a bounded composition. Explain each new exception in its source, record it in the stage contract, and cover it with `e2e/catalog/footprint-stability.spec.ts` without changing the whole category's default.
- **taste** `templates/make-graphics-project-read-siblings-through`: Make graphics in one project read as siblings through the per-family shape, type, and motion tokens in `docs/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md`. Judge every new category variant beside its lower-third counterpart, and preserve the optional project palette-and-typeface application through `brandPatch`.
- **taste** `templates/read-before-adding-design-judge-variety`: Read `docs/CATALOG_VARIETY.md` before adding a design, and judge variety from emitted output rather than declared family axes. Check its nearest neighbour with `node scripts/catalog-sameness.mjs` and its palette independence with `node scripts/palette-freedom.mjs`.
- **taste** `templates/treat-mark-slot-height-sized-band`: Treat a mark slot as a height-sized band with free width, no radius, and no crop. Declare `TemplateVariant.imageSlot: 'picture'` when the slot holds content artwork rather than a mark.
- **taste** `templates/treat-occasion-alias-admitting-designs-merely`: Treat an occasion alias as admitting designs, not merely ranking them. Do not attach an occasion spanning several shelves to an alias naming only one shelf; maintain the shelf-versus-moment vocabulary as an editorially measured list in the search gate.
- **taste** `templates/use-out-direction-entrance-curves-faster`: Use Out-direction entrance curves and faster In-direction exits, with Back Out for pops. Reserve Bounce and Elastic for playful graphics, and use linear `ease: 'none'` only for continuous motion such as rolls and marquees.
